title: Execution of a retained action
statement: Let $x$ be a bit string, $c$ a four-tape interpreter configuration on input $x$, $b$ a clock word, and suppose the control state of $c$ is the pending-action state carrying action bits $a$ and halting flag $h$. If the six-tape timed interpreter is started from the lift of $c$ with clock word $b$, but with its control set to the execute phase carrying $a$ and $h$, then one step produces the lift of the result of one step of the four-tape table interpreter from $c$, with clock word $b$ unchanged.
replaced:
From the six-tape lift of a pending-action configuration, with the control
replaced by the execute phase, one step of the timed interpreter applies the
retained source action: the result equals the lift of one step of the
unstopped table interpreter from the four-tape configuration, with the clock
word unchanged.
